pe_assessment: Snapshot trailing/forward P/E 14.24/13.24; trailing earnings include gains. Inference: normalized 23% ROTCE supports the valuation, with bank credit and capital risk retained.
margin_analysis: Q2 net income $21.2bn included significant gains; excluding them, $16.9bn and EPS $6.14 rose 13%. Normalized ROTCE was 23%, versus headline 29%.
debt_analysis: Standardized CET1 14.1% and $303bn capital are bank-appropriate solvency measures. Credit costs $2.5bn included $2.4bn net charge-offs and $149m reserve build; industrial FCF/net-debt measures are inappropriate.
growth_outlook: NII grew 10% to $25.6bn; excluding markets, 4% to $23.7bn. Average loans/deposits grew 10%/7%.
summary: Normalized profitability, capital and deposit growth support buy at the frozen forward multiple. Significant gains are excluded from the operating thesis, and credit deterioration remains a key risk.
